items.title: The Hotelisation of Real Estate: Inside the FHS Living Advisory Board at Maslow's Kensington
items.excerpt: The first FHS Living Advisory Board met at Maslow's Kensington to shape the Founding Edition in Paris. Investors, operators and developers from across European living debated one idea: the projects that outperform are run like hospitality.
